comparison.objective: Install a rack rail; record extracts a fitted collar with a prepared screw puller and recovers it.
comparison.physical_skill: Staged insertion/latching and fastening versus supporting an extraction tool, repeated screw regrasping, jaw spreading, and controlled unloading.
comparison.success_condition: Self-supporting installed rail versus collar fully removed into the tray and intact puller level on its rest for 2 s.
comparison.reason: Assembly and puller-based disassembly have opposite purposes and different force-control endpoints.
